name: Active Deployments
query:
SELECT
    pu.full_name AS Owner,
    COUNT(pu.owner) AS Project_Count,
    p.subject AS Subject,
    p.customer AS "Account Name"
FROM
    `tabProject User` pu
JOIN
    `tabProject` p ON pu.parent = p.name
WHERE
    p.status = 'In Progress'
    AND u.enabled = 1
GROUP BY
    pu.user
ORDER BY
    Project_Count DESC;
